title: What Can Ethereum Do for India? A Live Deliberation Workshop
description:
Ethereum describes itself as credibly neutral infrastructure guided by CROPS: censorship resistance, open source, privacy and security. But what does that mean for the problems people in India deal with every day?

This workshop invites participants as residents and citizens with local knowledge, not as crypto experts. Together they think through real problems, ask whether blockchains help, and ask when Ethereum’s neutrality and CROPS become a must-have rather than a nice-to-have. It’s also a chance to exercise civic muscles: deliberating and proposing with best-in-class tools.

No blockchain knowledge assumed.
abstract: Not in theory, but for the problems people live with every day: land records, education, civic life. Bring your local knowledge as a resident and citizen. Together we pick a problem, deliberate live on Agora, draft proposals and vote on them, mapping where we agree and which trade-offs still need work. No blockchain background needed. Bring your phone.
